entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I just can't seem to calm down...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Actually, have you had lunch yet?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Since we have the day off,[n]why don't we get together[n]and go out to eat?
entries.uk: У нас вихідний,[n]тож може, зберемося[n]й підемо кудись поїсти?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's an invitation from Lady Ann![n]You're going, right?
entries.uk: Запрошення від леді Анн![n]Ти ж підеш, правда?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: OK.[n]You're fine with going[n]to the diner, right?
entries.uk: Гаразд.[n]Ти ж не проти піти[n]в закусочну?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's meet up in Shibuya.[n]I'll let Ryuji know.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah...[n]Sorry for inviting you so suddenly.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm pretty hungry too. Naturally, I'll be[n]joining.
entries.uk: Я теж добряче зголоднів. Звісно, я[n]приєднаюся.
